name: Underrun
tagline: The corridor shooter, in a GIF. No server. The file is the save.
description:
This is Underrun in a GIF you keep. No jam site, no install, no game server. Close it and your best floor is still there, inside the file. Send the invite and extra soldiers drop into the same halls — the room is the link.

The year is 2718. The facility went dark. Spiders in the corridors, turrets around the corners, and every computer that runs the place is offline. Walk the halls, shoot what comes for you, and reboot each machine. When the last one on a floor comes back, you hop to the next.

Three floors. Health packs on the ground. The things in the dark do not wait.

On a phone it is a twin-stick: left thumb walks, right thumb aims and fires. On a computer it is WASD or the arrows, and the mouse to shoot.

An unofficial port of Underrun by phoboslab, the 2018 js13kGames entry. Music by Andreas Lösch. This copy adds the sticks a phone needs, the extra soldiers, and a save that lives in the file.
